newsitem.title: USA: Aasche completes private stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Aasche completes private stock offering.

text.p: Aasche Transportation Services Inc, a frozen food transportation company, said Thursday it completed the private offering of 540,558 shares of restricted common stock at a price of $3.70 a share.

The company also sold warrants to purchase 54,070 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $4.625 a share. The warrants are exercisable at any time within three years after June 24, 1997, the company said.
Net proceeds of about $1.9 million are being used to reduce outstanding indebtedness and for general corporate purposes, Aasche said.
Aasche shares were unchanged at 4-7/8 Thursday.
